entries.zh: 生发：能生利获息之钱；本钱孳息生财
entries.en: money that has gain; money that yields profit or interest (sheng-fa, “to generate profit”)

entries.zh: 赂：贿赂之钱；贿金
entries.en: bribe; bribe money (dinero de cohechos, “money of bribes”)
entries.notes: M 栏后半 sio chū 污损难辨（T99）且有 [残]，按残损规则降级；赂与西语 cohechos（贿赂）由 L/H/R 三栏互证，主释义仍可立。

entries.zh: 银钱：银钱、钱财；承“贿赂之钱”词头，指用作贿赂的银钱
entries.en: silver money, cash (listed under the lemma “bribe money”: money used for bribes)
entries.notes: M 栏有 [划改残迹待校]；汉字银钱与 R 对音 xiên chiēn 明确，词头承 Dinero de cohechos。

entries.zh: 财利：钱财利益；承“贿赂之钱”词头，指贿赂所得之财利
entries.en: wealth and profit; gains (here: profit obtained by bribery)

entries.zh: 本钱：本钱、本金；经营放贷所投之本
entries.en: principal; capital stock, money invested or lent

entries.zh: 汗血钱：血汗挣来之钱；劳作工钱
entries.en: sweat-and-blood money; wages earned by toil (dinero del trabajo)

entries.zh: 备辨钱（备办钱）：备办支应之钱；办事开销的备用钱
entries.en: money provided for expenses; provisioning money
entries.notes: 词头有 gastos/pasos 之疑、汉字辨/辦之疑、R 首字 kỹ/pỹ 之疑；四栏仍互证为备办用钱之义。

entries.zh: 盘缠：盘缠；路费、旅费
entries.en: travel money; travelling expenses (p'an-ch'ien)
entries.notes: 西语尾词 xalotage 难辨、M 栏连写难辨；义由汉字盘缠与 R 对音 pôan chiēn 明确。

entries.zh: 现钱：现钱、现款；当面即付之现金
entries.en: cash; ready money paid down (dinero de contado)

entries.zh: 生发：能生利获息之钱；本钱孳息生财
entries.en: money that has gain; money that yields profit or interest (sheng-fa, “to generate profit”)

entries.zh: 回钱（疑为“会钱”）：众人合会共凑之钱；社团共有之钱
entries.en: money of the community; pooled money of a money-circle (hui-ch'ian, tontine contribution)
entries.notes: 汉字首字有回/田之疑；依西语 comunidad（共同体）与闽俗合会拟为“会钱”，系推断非定论。

entries.zh: 私己钱：私己钱、私房钱；妇人自己挣得、私自存留之钱
entries.en: private purse money; a woman's own earnings kept for herself
entries.notes: 西语尾词 ganaposy 疑为 ganado por sy 连写；M 栏另附 hay quā chỹ̃ 一串难解，义由汉字私己钱与词头大意互证。

entries.zh: 中人钱：中人钱；付与居间中人（牙保）的酬劳，为两面服务所出之钱
entries.en: middleman's fee; go-between's commission for serving both parties
entries.notes: 词头尾词 ambos 有难辨之疑；中人钱义与 el servicio（居间服务）相合，汉字三栏明确。

entries.zh: 当钱：当钱；典当质押所放之钱
entries.en: pawn money; money advanced on a pledge (dinero sobre prenda)

entries.zh: 利令智昏：财利使人智昏，钱财蒙蔽理智
entries.en: profit makes the mind dark; money obscures prudence (proverb)

entries.zh: 钱动人心：钱财打动人心
entries.en: money moves the heart; people are swayed by money
entries.notes: 西语尾词 nosy 难辨（疑为 nostro 等残文）；义由汉字钱动人心三栏明确。

entries.zh: 缘钱：缘钱；僧道化缘所得布施之钱
entries.en: alms money (money collected by monks in hua-yuan, begging for alms)
entries.notes: 汉字有缘钱/缘米之疑；R 对音 yèn 与西语 limosna（施舍）支持缘钱义。

entries.zh: 天主：天主；天主教所称上帝真神
entries.en: God (T'ien-chu, “Lord of Heaven”, the Catholic term)

entries.zh: 太极：太极；西语原以 Dios 对译，原稿划去
entries.en: t'ai-chi, the Supreme Ultimate (the Spanish gloss “Dios” is struck through in the original)
entries.notes: 词头与 M 栏均有划去，M 后旁注 Esvia 难辨且有 T99 污损；汉字太极仍可辨，Dios 对译已废。

entries.zh: 祇：祇；地祇，司地上万物之神灵
entries.en: ch'i: spirit, deity of earthly things (as in ti-ch'i, terrestrial spirits)
entries.notes: M 栏旁注小字难辨（[疑]）；主体对音 quỹ/kỹ 与祇字明确。

entries.zh: 灶君：灶君、灶神；司灶厨饮食之神
entries.en: tsao-chün, the Kitchen God (god of the stoves/kitchens)
entries.notes: M 栏旁注 [残:小字难辨]、西语尾词 Bender 难辨；灶君本义四栏互证清晰，按残损规则降级。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕：字作“洋洋”，或为浩瀚盛大之貌，四栏难以互证
entries.en: 〔damaged, gloss uncertain〕: characters read yang-yang “vast, expansive”, but the four-syllable guanhua transcription does not match
entries.notes: R 栏四音节 liâu zū siâng siōng 与洋洋不合且后两音节难辨，M 首音节污损（T99），西语词头亦难解，材料不足故存疑。
